notes.title: Update v. 0.06c
notes.notes:
In this update we focused on the first intro scene. We still want to fully finish the Intro in 0.06 final patch.

You can see many polished things in the first intro scene now (it's still not finished, we polish more and more things everyday).
We also added golden clock cursor for waiting intervals in scenes.
Go and check it out! :)

As always thanks for your time and feedbacks!

Sincerely your Gaming Cats Studio!

notes.title: Update v. 0.05
notes.notes:
Update v. 0.05

- Upgraded "cellar scene" 
You can now check the new look of whole scene. 

- Fixed movement in all scenes
There was some weird movements on scenes (include character zooming).
There is still some glitches - will be fixed.

- Added animations to "bedroom scene".
You can now check new animations.

This is changelog from yesterday.
Today will be ready new update (we try to put updates and fixes every day).
